results.title: Consolidate speculative decoding correctness and acceptance tests
results.body:
Speculative decoding tests repeat engine setup, GSM8K evaluation, acceptance-metric extraction, and threshold assertions across several suites. This makes fixes harder to apply consistently and makes it unclear which helper to extend for a new drafting method. We should share the common evaluation code while keeping each test's purpose and workload explicit.

## Current PRs:
* https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/60239 by @adixg 
  * tests/v1/e2e/spec_decode/eagle/utils.py
  * tests/v1/e2e/spec_decode/mtp/_correctness.py
  * tests/v1/e2e/spec_decode/speculators/test_speculators.py
  * common code to: tests/v1/e2e/spec_decode/utils.py
* https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/59602/ by @Dyslex7c
  * tests/v1/e2e/spec_decode/acceptance_rates/dflash/test_dflash.py
  * tests/v1/e2e/spec_decode/acceptance_rates/dspark/test_dspark.py
  * tests/v1/spec_decode/test_speculators_correctness.py
  * common code to: tests/v1/e2e/spec_decode/acceptance_rates/utils.py

## Types of checks

- **Configuration and integration:** Checkpoint auto-detection, inferred target/draft models, method, speculative-token count, and basic generation.
- **Output correctness:** GSM8K accuracy and comparisons against non-speculative generation.
- **Acceptance regressions:** Overall acceptance rate/length and per-position acceptance against reference values.
- **Runtime behavior:** Async scheduling, unintended GPU–CPU synchronization, tensor/pipeline parallelism, and attention-backend compatibility.
- **Component correctness:** Rejection sampling, proposer/kernel behavior, dynamic SD, and adaptive verification.

These checks overlap in their setup and evaluation code, but they are not interchangeable.
For example, `test_speculators_model()` checks auto-detection and basic generation, whereas `assert_draft_model_correctness()` checks acceptance thresholds, optional GSM8K accuracy, and async scheduling.
Neither compares outputs against a non-speculative reference.

## Deduplication opportunities

### 1. Share accuracy and acceptance evaluation

[Draft-model tests](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/15ba199f0/tests/v1/e2e/spec_decode/draft_model/test_draft_model.py#L310), [XPress](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/15ba199f0/tests/v1/e2e/spec_decode/acceptance_rates/xpress/test_xpress.py#L48), [DSpark](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/15ba199f0/tests/v1/e2e/spec_decode/acceptance_rates/dspark/test_dspark.py#L91), [DFlash](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/15ba199f0/tests/v1/e2e/spec_decode/acceptance_rates/dflash/test_dflash.py#L109), and [speculators correctness](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/15ba199f0/tests/v1/spec_decode/test_speculators_correctness.py#L186) repeat this workflow.

Extend shared configuration and evaluation helpers rather than copying the test body for each method.
Preserve the distinction between acceptance measured on separate prompts before GSM8K (draft model/XPress) and acceptance measured during GSM8K (DSpark/DFlash/speculators).
Sampling, batching, chat templates, and thresholds must remain explicit.

### 2. Consolidate acceptance-metric extraction

[Speculators correctness](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/15ba199f0/tests/v1/spec_decode/test_speculators_correctness.py#L92), [EAGLE3 acceptance](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/15ba199f0/tests/v1/spec_decode/test_acceptance_length.py#L180), and [shared SD utilities](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/15ba199f0/tests/v1/e2e/spec_decode/utils.py#L189) contain overlapping calculations.

Use a common implementation for overall and per-position metrics, preserving denominators, zero-counter handling, and cumulative versus delta measurements.
Keep regression thresholds at the test/configuration level.

### 3. Share reference-comparison orchestration

[EAGLE](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/15ba199f0/tests/v1/e2e/spec_decode/eagle/utils.py#L20), [MTP](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/15ba199f0/tests/v1/e2e/spec_decode/mtp/test_mtp.py#L152), and [speculators integration](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/15ba199f0/tests/v1/e2e/spec_decode/speculators/test_speculators.py#L28) already share `assert_request_outputs_match()`, but repeat reference/speculative generation and optional GSM8K evaluation.

Factor out the repeated orchestration while preserving method-specific setup and match thresholds.
Keep targeted regressions, such as MTP placeholder handling, separate.

### 4. Reuse the existing dataset acceptance helper

DFlash and Gemma4 MTP already use [`run_acceptance_length_eval()`](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/15ba199f0/tests/v1/e2e/spec_decode/acceptance_rates/utils.py#L38).
Reuse it for future suites with the same sequential, per-prompt GSM8K/MT-Bench/HumanEval workload rather than introducing another evaluator.

~Start with metric extraction and accuracy/acceptance helpers in small changes.
Keep auto-detection assertions, runtime-specific checks, and component tests explicit rather than folding everything into one universal test.~

One example of reusing test code at high-level: https://github.com/tomasruizt/vllm/commit/b9a1ec2bdb12eceff6e840c2f1d69ed1e4425862

results.title: [Bug][SM120] MTP speculative decoding acceptance rate drops to 0% on nightly with native FLASHINFER_MLA_SPARSE_SM120 backend (GLM-5.3-Flash)
results.body:
## Environment
- vLLM: `0.30.1rc1.dev539+g5b6b657e1` (nightly wheel, 2026-10-02 build, commit `5b6b657e1`)
- Hardware: 8x RTX PRO 6000 (SM120), PCIe, no NVLink
- Model: GLM-5.3-Flash (FP8 checkpoint, TP=8)
- flashinfer-python: 0.7.0
- Base image: vllm-openai v0.30.0 + nightly wheel force-reinstall (no-deps)

## Observed behavior
MTP speculative decoding drafts tokens but the acceptance rate is **exactly 0%** — every drafted token is rejected. Decode speed falls back to non-speculative baseline (~80 tok/s vs ~163-190 tok/s with working MTP).

SpecDecoding metrics from server log (eager mode, spec_tokens=3, 512-token essay generation):

```
Mean acceptance length: 1.00, Accepted throughput: 0.00 tokens/s,
Drafted throughput: 82.20 tokens/s, Accepted: 0 tokens, Drafted: 822 tokens,
Per-position acceptance rate: 0.000, 0.000, 0.000, Avg Draft acceptance rate: 0.0%
```

## Three-leg isolation (all on identical config: fp8, TP8, mem 0.94, block-size 2304, mtp, max-model-len 1M)

| Leg | Mode | spec_tokens | Acceptance |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | CUDA graph (default) | 3 | 0% (76-83 tok/s) |
| 2 | --enforce-eager | 3 | 0% |
| 3 | --enforce-eager | 1 | 0% (100 drafted / 0 accepted) |

All three legs rule out graph-mode interaction and multi-step draft-forward as the cause.

## Key log lines

```
(Worker_TP0) speculator.py:116 Fused multi-step draft decode is not supported by attention backend(s) DEEPSEEK_V32_INDEXER, FLASHINFER_MLA_SPARSE_SM120, KPOOL_TAIL; falling back to rebuilding attention metadata between draft steps.
(APIServer) speculative.py:1136 method `glm5_next_mtp` is deprecated and replaced with mtp.
(APIServer) interface.py:1336 Unknown vLLM environment variable detected: VLLM_ATTENTION_BACKEND
```

The nightly auto-selects the native `FLASHINFER_MLA_SPARSE_SM120` backend (`VLLM_ATTENTION_BACKEND` env no longer recognized). The target model's forward is correct (generations are coherent), but the MTP drafter output is systematically rejected — suggesting the draft forward pass produces wrong logits under the native SM120 attention path.

## Working baseline (for contrast)
A community image based on v0.30.0 with a backported SM90 NoPE sparse-MLA path (forced `VLLM_ATTENTION_BACKEND=FLASHINFER_MLA_SPARSE_SM90`, flashinfer 0.6.18.dev20260819) on the **same hardware, same checkpoint, same spec config** achieves:
- Mean acceptance ~60.7%, acceptance length ~2.8
- decode 163-190 tok/s

So the regression is specific to the nightly native SM120 backend's interaction with MTP drafting (or the drafter's attention path), not the model or hardware.

## Reproduce

```
docker run --gpus all -v /path/GLM-5.3-Flash:/model:ro \
  -v vllm-0.30.1rc1.dev539...x86_64.whl:/tmp/nightly.whl:ro \
  --entrypoint bash vllm/vllm-openai:v0.30.0 \
  -c 'pip install --no-deps --force-reinstall /tmp/nightly.whl && \
      vllm serve /model --served-model-name glm-5.3-flash --trust-remote-code \
      --tensor-parallel-size 8 --quantization fp8 --max-model-len 1048576 \
      --max-num-seqs 256 --gpu-memory-utilization 0.94 --block-size 2304 \
      --no-enable-flashinfer-autotune --enable-auto-tool-choice \
      --tool-call-parser glm47 --reasoning-parser glm45 \
      --speculative-config "{\"method\":\"mtp\",\"num_speculative_tokens\":3}"'
```

Then generate ~512 tokens and check `SpecDecoding metrics` lines: acceptance 0%.

Happy to provide full server logs or run additional diagnostics on request.

results.title: fix(ngram): sync ngram_gpu acceptance rate to match CPU
results.body:
When ngram_gpu produces per-request valid draft token counts, use them to
truncate the draft token IDs before returning, avoiding invalid tokens being
passed to downstream consumers.

## Purpose

Fix speculative decoding acceptance rate undercounting in **sync scheduling**
mode with ngram_gpu. When the ngram proposer fails to match, draft token IDs
contain invalid entries (filled with `-1`). These invalid tokens were returned
as-is by `_get_draft_token_ids_cpu()`, inflating the draft-token denominator
in `make_spec_decoding_stats()` and making the reported acceptance rate appear
lower than it actually is.

**Before:** `_get_draft_token_ids_cpu()` returned all draft tokens including
invalid `-1` placeholders.

**After:** It now reads `_num_valid_draft_tokens_cpu` (already populated during
`execute_model()`) and truncates each request's draft token list to the valid
count, so only legitimately drafted tokens reach the scheduler stats.

## Test Plan

Run any model with ngram_gpu speculative decoding in **sync** scheduling mode
and observe the acceptance rate metric.

```bash
python -m vllm.entrypoints.openai.api_server \
    --model <model_path> \
    --speculative-config '{"method":"ngram_gpu","num_speculative_tokens":5,"prompt_lookup_max":5,"prompt_lookup_min":1}' \
    --disable-async-scheduling
